description: Follow-up governance defect from register-adapter-ddl-rewrites-under-sql-compat (deferral #233). SCHEMA_EMIT is now enforced by scripts/compat_lint.py, but QUERY_ADAPTER still lacks a settled detector boundary and negative-control acceptance test. Current inventory includes registered ClickHouse/StarRocks query rewrites and platform-local Firebolt/Redshift cache-session settings whose inclusion or exemption must be explicit. Group the boundary decision, registry/inventory enforcement, exemptions, negative controls, and CI wiring in this item.

item_meta.blocked_reason: SCHEMA_EMIT is already enforced by scripts/compat_lint.py. QUERY_ADAPTER needs one policy decision before implementation: should drift detection cover only dialect branches, or every platform-local rewrite/session-setting function discovered by inventory.py? The broader choice currently includes ClickHouse/StarRocks registered rewrites plus unregistered Firebolt/Redshift cache-session settings that may require explicit exemptions. Because this is a soundness gate, the detector boundary and exemption policy must be specified with a negative control before fail-CI wiring.

verifications.expected: all tests pass, including an unregistered QUERY_ADAPTER negative control
